evals.prompt: Tell me about who I am based on my chart.
evals.expected_output: A grounded response that names specific placements from this chart (Cancer lagna, Moon in Mrigashirsha, current Jupiter mahadasha), speaks in second person, and avoids generic personality language.

passages.title: Cancer Ascendant (Karka Lagna)
passages.content: You live in contradiction. Your understanding is firm but your principles stay flexible. You're grateful inside but haughty in public. You master others, then feel the sting of kinsmen. Your important work tends to happen in foreign places. Your inner and outer selves don't always line up — the practice is noticing which one is speaking.

passages.title: Moon in the 11th House
passages.content: The 11th is gains and long-desired things fulfilled. Moon here concentrates both into a visibly abundant life. Fame tends to follow, often through emotional or artistic expression. What you've longed for tends to arrive, in time.

passages.title: Moon in the 11th House (Phaladeepika)
passages.content: Moon in the 11th gives high-mindedness, long life, real wealth, children, and a steady flow of people who help. The 11th is gain; the Moon there ensures the gain is broad rather than narrow. Aim higher than feels natural — the chart supports it. Friends and supporters will fill in the gaps.

passages.title: Moon in Mrigashirsha
passages.content: Your principles bend when they need to. You're capable. Underneath there's a bit of timidity, paired with good speech and active habits. Wealth adds up. Your sensual side is alive. Mrigashirsha's Moon moves — activity is your native state, and your life follows that.

passages.title: Mars in the 7th House
passages.content: Mars in your 7th carries the Sun's pattern here: partnership is where you get tested. Public or relational setbacks through intimate partners or business counterparts are common. The other person reflects back what you'd rather not see. The work is humility inside partnership.

passages.title: Mars in the 7th House (Phaladeepika)
passages.content: Mars in the 7th is the classical Kuja Dosha placement. Drawn into improper actions in partnership, body afflictions through stress-related illness, restless wandering, and friction or loss in marriage. The drive that should serve the partnership keeps subverting it. The work is conscious de-escalation in close relationships — Mars wants to push exactly where it shouldn't.
